column1: # carrier_genes.tsv: the genes of the couple carrier screen (step 39, og couple screen).
# One row per gene. chrom, start and end: the gene's GRCh38 span (1-based, inclusive) from the
# gene lines of GENCODE release 99 (basic annotation). inheritance: AR (autosomal, or in a
# pseudoautosomal region) or XL (chrX outside the PARs). lists: where the gene comes from:
#             tier 3: the 97 autosomal recessive genes of its tables 1 to 5 and the 16 X-linked
#             genes of table 6; condition names from those tables
#   ACOG      the conditions of ACOG Committee Opinions 690 and 691 (2017): cystic fibrosis, spinal
#             muscular atrophy, the hemoglobinopathies, fragile X and the Ashkenazi Jewish panel
#   Orphanet  every other gene of an Orphanet disorder with autosomal recessive or X-linked
#             inheritance (Orphadata en_product6 and en_product9_ages of 2026-01-02, CC BY 4.0,
#             https://www.orphadata.com), with a disease-causing germline association that
#             Orphanet assessed; condition: the first such disorder by name
# severity: alleles of the gene that are not a full loss of function, separated by ";": each is
#   hypomorph or pseudodeficiency, then chrom:pos:ref:alt (GRCh38), then a name; "." for none. Such
#   an allele never makes a carrier finding on its own (the couple screen, step 39, and the
#   carrier list of the sample report). With a called deletion of the gene it is a second hit (the
#   two-hit lines of the sample report, og summary collect). In the couple screen a
#   hypomorph beside a full loss of function in the other partner's same gene is a shared gene.
# Rebuilt with: og couple genes (docs/39-couple.md says how).
